Detail comes from the accrual Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Net Position - Business-type Activities (p6): total operating revenues 683,948 (Water 474,464 = user fees 444,157 + misc 30,307; Sewer 209,484 = user fees 205,484 + misc 4,000) + interest income 17,227 (15,126 + 2,101) = 701,175. Every p6 line is in detail once; no line missing or duplicated. No fix.
